Colour with a job

Black steps back. The brand blue and its navy carry the text; eight hues give every vendor, category and section its own colour; status colours keep their meaning.

6 · Rules that keep it calm

  • Status colours (green paid, amber waiting, red rejected or late) are reserved for status; identity colours never reuse them for meaning.
  • Amounts stay navy. Red appears only for late, negative or failed.
  • Colour never works alone: every dot has a label, every avatar has a name.
  • The login gradient appears at most once per page, on the one number that matters most.
  • Dark theme gets its own steps of the same hues later; nothing here is final until checked there.
